code_review.scope: Shared workspace contracts, SQLite transactions, file storage, typed records, public operations, integrated tests, and current documentation.
concerns: duplicate behavior and sources of truth
resolved_findings: Reject normalized file-versus-directory input path collisions.
Validate every recovery job snapshot before changing records or removing orphan files.
Permit optional SQLite journals to disappear before or after opening during normal concurrent commits.
Verify the workspace application marker and structured table, key, and session relationship metadata before accepting schema v1.
code_review.result: No remaining material blockers in the combined implementation and documentation at the recorded source commit.

acceptance_review.reviewer: Independent tooling agent, reviewed by root and scope_review
evidence: Fresh Python processes reopen a stored parent revision, clone, and saved-project checkpoint.
Independent process writers preserve both sessions and reject one stale competing job update.
A process interrupted during artifact input leaves no readable artifact manifest.
A producer stream failure cannot supply the input artifact required to save a completed revision.
A changed clone preserves parsed parent input values and its saved lineage.
Unsafe links, missing files, incompatible schemas, and unsupported input relationships produce visible failures.
Both new schema regression cases fail before the reviewed fix and pass afterward.

visual_review.result: The intended overview, clone/checkpoint, recovery, and schema content is visible and legible without material layout problems.
Content and navigation are readable. The local setup formula renders with the expected mathematical notation and subscripts.
Visible current scope, navigation, and tables are legible without material overlap or clipping.
The complete workspace error table, shared contract additions, and P03 plan section are visible and legible.

limits: Visual checks cover only the named 1440-by-1800 viewports. Long code lines require horizontal scrolling, and uncaptured page regions were not visually reviewed.
The installed example reopens through a second store object in one process. The maintained acceptance suite separately establishes fresh-process reopening.
Tests use real temporary SQLite databases and files on the selected host. They do not establish power-loss behavior or network filesystem support.
The trusted workspace owner can change files outside the API. The store does not hash or parse artifact content, decode images, or verify saved ResInsight project contents.
The caller must stop its job controller before selecting recovery jobs. The store does not inspect or signal processes.
No ResInsight, MCP server, OPM, or Julia adapter is implemented or exercised by P03.
